lessons.title: What Is Reinforcement Learning?
lessons.description: Agents, environments, rewards and the trial-and-error loop that powers RL.

lessons.title: Markov Decision Processes
lessons.description: The formal framework: states, actions, transitions, rewards and the Markov property.

lessons.title: Dynamic Programming
lessons.description: Solve MDPs exactly with policy evaluation, policy iteration and value iteration.

lessons.title: Monte Carlo Methods
lessons.description: Learn from complete episodes: average returns to estimate state values without a model.

lessons.title: Temporal Difference Learning
lessons.description: Learn from partial episodes with bootstrapping — the idea at the heart of modern RL.

lessons.title: Q-Learning
lessons.description: Off-policy control: learn action values with Q-learning and watch agents improve from scratch.

lessons.title: Exploration vs Exploitation
lessons.description: Balance trying new things with using what works: epsilon-greedy, UCB and optimism.

lessons.title: Function Approximation
lessons.description: Scale RL beyond tables: approximate Q-values with linear and neural models.

lessons.title: Deep Q-Networks (DQN)
lessons.description: Play Atari from pixels: experience replay, target networks and the tricks that made DQN work.

lessons.title: Policy Gradient Methods
lessons.description: Optimize the policy directly — REINFORCE and the log-probability trick.

lessons.title: Actor-Critic Methods
lessons.description: Two networks in harmony: the actor picks actions, the critic judges them with bootstrapped values.

lessons.title: PPO & Modern Policy Optimization
lessons.description: Stable, sample-efficient updates with clipping — the default choice in modern RL.

lessons.title: Reward Design
lessons.description: Rewards shape everything: sparse vs dense, shaping and the specification problem.

lessons.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning
lessons.description: Learn policies from logged data without a live environment — conservative and practical.

lessons.title: Imitation Learning
lessons.description: Learn from demonstrations: behavioral cloning and DAgger for expert-like behavior.

lessons.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
lessons.description: Multiple learners interacting: cooperation, competition, and the games they create.

lessons.title: RL in Games
lessons.description: From Atari to AlphaGo: self-play, Monte Carlo tree search, and superhuman play.

lessons.title: RL for Robotics
lessons.description: Physical agents learning motor skills: sim-to-real, reward shaping and safety in the real world.

lessons.title: RL for Recommender Systems
lessons.description: Ranking as sequential decisions: contextual bandits and long-term user value.

lessons.title: Evaluating RL Agents
lessons.description: Measures beyond total reward: returns curves, sample efficiency and robustness.

lessons.title: Reinforcement Learning Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course, pick a domain, and plan RL projects that build real skill.
